name: Downs Syndrome
overview: Scripture affirms the inherent dignity and value of every human being as created in the image of God, as stated in Genesis 1:27. The Lord's sovereign hand is evident in the formation of each person, including those with differences such as speech or hearing challenges, as Exodus 4:11 highlights God's intentional design. Psalm 139 further emphasizes God's intimate knowledge and careful creation of each individual, formed wonderfully in the womb. These truths remind us that all life, including those with Down syndrome, reflects God's marvelous workmanship and purpose.
